entries.title: Lessons come back as cards, games get their own projects
entries.body: Asking to learn or practise something, like a math quiz, now starts lessons on cards instead of building a new panel. A new game gets its own project setup card: a game for fun suggests keeping changes on this computer, merging them automatically and quick care, and a game meant to ship suggests the usual settings and a plan first. Panels you already have stay as they are.
entries.noPicture: This changes how asks reach existing lesson cards and project setup, not the appearance of those surfaces.
